issues.description: Method PersonResource.getAllPersons(): the template declares the controller handler method as public, while the solution declares it as private. Template: "public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()" (exposes the handler as public). Solution: "private ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()" (handler marked private). This visibility difference between template and solution can confuse students about the expected access level for Spring MVC controller handler methods and which visibility they should use when implementing endpoints.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Prefer declaring the controller handler method as public in both template and solution to match common Spring MVC conventions and avoid student confusion. Example fix in solution: change "private ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()" to "public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()".
